snippet.title: Falsy Values
snippet.description:
Falsy Values is a world-class conference and workshop series for front-end developers. The 2-day event is packed with content for coders who love to build the face of the web and the community around it.

1st day, conference talks, provides deep insights about the future of the web and 2nd day, hands-on workshops, offers education in the latest tools, technologies, and practices from the world’s leading experts. Parties and social events bring everyone together to share knowledge, make memories and build relationships that we hope last long after the event is over.

Falsy Values is brought to you by the Front‑Trends Team.
